_comment: Upstream skills copied unchanged at a pinned commit, installed with the toolkit's own skills. Never edit a vendored folder: scripts/vendor_sync.py --update replaces it whole and records file hashes that scripts/check.py verifies. Put any guard against an upstream rule in the toolkit skill that uses it.

emilkowalski-skills.note: Only these three: animate, emil-design-eng and prototype overlap impeccable, which owns general UI design, prototyping and motion creation. The copies still name sibling skills that are not installed (animate, animate-expo, emil-design-eng, prototype, choreograph); impeccable covers those jobs. review-animations sets disable-model-invocation: true, so in Claude Code a model cannot call it; toolkit skills read its SKILL.md and STANDARDS.md instead.
